coordinator_scope: body transformation, care and ecology; not requester locks
concept: Self-care of a tide membrane releases an ancient migration in a last-sun railway conservatory that is a minute organ of a colossal exterior ecology.

gates.criterion: Both separate arms, continuous forearm-to-membrane attachment, right-hand support and membrane-edge contact with moss cradle are jointly visible.
The wetted membrane visibly opens while a dry portion stays curled, making care consequential.
Pale migrating organisms can be followed from wetted membrane to moss and hanging root, and that root visibly joins the vast exterior organism.
A weak swollen red sun, exhausted horizon and disused salt-worn railway are visible together.
Maintained seedlings, steaming kettle and towel/warm basin establish practical inhabited care within the exhausted railway.
The vast organism visibly dwarfs the railway refuge and continues beyond the roof/frame; its material root links it to the local care event.
Face proportions and short dark bob with wispy fringe visibly resemble the supplied portrait at the actual output scale.

verdict_rule: All components of every gate must be visible; partial or unobservable is not complete pass. User artistic preference remains pending.
